verdict.rationale: xAI documents a model versioning scheme: pinned model IDs plus `<modelname>` (latest stable) and `<modelname>-latest` aliases. It also publishes a dated retirement guide that names the retired slugs and redirects them to `grok-4.3`, so code keeps working without changes. However, deprecation is shown only as a single event-specific migration guide, not a standing policy. missing for 10: a general written deprecation policy with guaranteed notice periods and support windows, documented API-surface versioning and compatibility guarantees beyond model slugs, independent corroboration of how retirements played out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: `<modelname>` is aliased to the latest stable version. `<modelname>-latest` is aliased to the latest version
requests to the retired model slugs above will automatically redirect to `grok-4.3`. The slugs themselves continue to resolve, so you do not need to change your code
